answer: A concrete approach: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its glacier recurs, its prism survives audit, and a harbor from an unlinked peer confirms it.
